title: Urea-mediated Dissociation to Alleviate False-Positive Treponema Pallidum Antibodies Detected by ELISA
author: Qiang Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xdwfi7e
materials: Using different methods to detect TP antibodies, and to understand the characteristics of different samples, so as to facilitate grouping.
Sensitivity evaluation of the improved TP-ELISA.

steps.title: Collect Clinical Samples
steps.instruction: Collect clinical samples required for the experiment, specifically focusing on samples that yielded false-positive results when detected by ELISA.

steps.title: Perform Pre-experiment
steps.instruction: Conduct a pre-experiment to explore the basic conditions required for urea dissociation.

steps.title: Perform Formal Experiment
steps.instruction: Conduct a formal experiment to determine and select the optimal conditions for urea dissociation.
